text:
maria: Throwing out a new micro-experiment idea: a 'Playground Challenge' tied to launch posts + a short bench-and-build webinar. Offer a small in-playground credit for completing a 5-minute challenge, then route high-intent responders to demo flow. :sparkles:
kevin: Nice. How is this different from past credit promos?
maria: Two differences: 1) credit is granted only after they submit a tiny runnable snippet in the playground (so we measure real intent). 2) posts will carry a compact benchmark callout (p95 latency + token-efficiency) and a 1-click challenge CTA that pre-fills the playground.
sam: Metrics? What do we measure as activation?
maria: Primary: 7-day engaged = did_run_challenge && made_api_call_after_challenge. Secondary: webinar attendance rate, conversion to paid trial in 30 days, median tokens/day. Also measure lead quality via sales-touchback.
olivia: Routing plan: include campaign tags in webhook: utm_campaign, post_slot, challenge_id, and model_pref. Run the classifier on signups and set routing tags: demo_candidate=true/false, region. Demo candidates -> sales-assist queue w/ challenge result link.
emma: For the challenge itself, can we create two variants? A = frontend-streaming example (low latency focus), B = batch-embedding pipeline (cost focus). See if benchmark narrative aligning with the challenge type lifts conversion.
kevin: So factorial: post narrative (bench vs story) x challenge type (A vs B) x credit channel (instant in-playground vs email after submission). That's 8 cells if we include both narrative variants and both channels. Might be heavy.
maria: Let's reduce: narrative (bench vs story) x challenge (A vs B) x credit_delivery (in-playground immediate vs email delayed) = 8 cells but we can cap traffic to key markets and aim for total N=800 signups over 3 weeks.
sam: I'll map event names: `playground.challenge_started`, `playground.challenge_submitted`, `playground.credit_granted`, `activation.flag`, `post.impression`. We'll log `experiment_id` and `cell` on each event.
maria: Good. Can you add a tiny webhook payload example in the tracker?
sam: Example payload for inbound hook:
```json
{
  "user_id":"u_987",
  "experiment_id":"EXP-3456789012",
  "cell":"narrative-bench__challenge-A__credit-inplay",
  "post_slot":"org_twitter_1",
  "utm_campaign":"playground-launch-1"
}
```
kevin: UX note: pre-fill the playground with the challenge scaffold and a one-click "Run & Submit". If they click run, mark challenge_started; if they press submit, collect output and timestamp.
olivia: Routing thresholds: demo_candidate if classifier_score > 0.7 AND challenge_score >= 0.6. We'll auto-assign to sales-assist and include the challenge link. Region NA + demo_candidate gets prioritized webinar seat.
emma: Marketing copy ideas (bench variant): "See how Redwood serves bursts at <100ms p95 — try a 5-min playground build and earn credits." Story variant: "How Acme cut inference cost in half — try the 5-min challenge to see how."
maria: Growth-bot, please create the experiment and a short allocation plan.
growth-bot: Created experiment EXP-3456789012. Cells: 8, allocation uniform. Webhook: /webhooks/exp-3456789012. Track events: playground.challenge_started, playground.challenge_submitted, playground.credit_granted, activation.flag.
sam: Dashboard ask: conversion funnel (post_impression -> signup -> challenge_started -> challenge_submitted -> credit_granted -> activation). Cohorts by cell, region, and source. Also compute median delay between signup and challenge_start.
kevin: Locking down timeline: post creative + challenge scaffolds by Wed, playground prefill + run/submit flow by Thu, webhook + routing by Fri, dashboard ready by next Tue. Webinar to run Thu next week.
maria: Risks: spammy submissions (we'll gate to verified email), social spike imbalance (monitor first 48h), and playground abuse. We'll rate-limit per IP and dedupe identical payloads.
emma: Also add a 2-question micro-survey after they submit: what was most helpful? Did the benchmark/story change your view? Simple radio options.
olivia: Ops: I'll add fields `challenge_score` and `classifier_score` to the routing payload. Also add `credit_channel` to help analysis.
sam: One more: log `snippet_hash` on submit so sales can quickly view unique code without storing raw secrets.
maria: OK action items: Maria -> creative + one-slide benchmark; Emma -> challenge scaffolds; Kevin -> UX review + run/submit flow; Olivia -> webhooks + routing; Sam -> tracking + dashboard; Growth-bot -> experiment created. Sync Monday 9:30. :calendar:
